title: The State of Sexual Union, 2026
author: Susan Block
content:
If you’re too busy or overwhelmed by life or AI to listen to my sixth annual
[State of the Sexual Union address (2026)](https://drsusanblock.com/active-
radio-6), delivered live 2/14/2026 on  _Active Radio_ hosted by [Hartley
Pleshaw](https://drsusanblock.tv/main/sets.php?id=1735) on [WCAP-AM
980](https://980wcap.com/) – now
[available](https://drsusanblock.com/sotsu-2026-transcript) for your [aural
edification](https://drsusanblock.com/active-radio-5) – here’s my single-word
2026 prescription for our very sickened society: **Therapy**.

We need it. I need it, and I’m pretty sure you do too.

Last year’s [State of the Sexual Union
(2025)](https://drsusanblock.com/active-radio-5) was subtitled the Year of
Living Precariously. This year, we have fallen off the Cliff of Precarity into
a Sea of Slop and Slime. So, 2026 is our Year of Needing Therapy.

**Grief’s a Bitch**

I need therapy (and yes, I’m getting some, thank you) primarily because I’m
grieving for my beloved husband Max who [passed
away](https://drsusanblock.com/rip-max) on May 13, 2025 after a terrible
[stroke](https://drsusanblock.com/birthday-healing) that shattered our world.

Grief is a bitch, Brothers and Sisters, Lovers and Sinners. And no, I’m not
talking about [Erika](https://drsusanblock.com/max-collage-
valentine#ErikaKirk) [Kirk](https://drsusanblock.com/go-
bonobos-2026#ErikaKirk). Well, not _really_ …

I’m talking about the deep loss of my Great Love. Essentially, the State of
_My_ Sexual Union is [grieving](https://drsusanblock.com/bottomless-grief-
topless-cake). Even when lovely things happen – a hug from a friend,
[flowers](https://drsusanblock.com/go-bonobos-2025#flowers) blooming in our
[Bonoboville](https://drsusanblock.com/bonoboville) garden, a lick from our
[sweet dog](https://drsusanblock.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/IMG_2012.jpg),
a colleague composing a beautiful
[song](https://soundcloud.com/davidrovics/captain-max) for us – I still
grieve, wishing Max were here to experience them with me.

If the State of _Your_ Sexual Union is that you too are grieving, and even if
you’re not, I imagine you could benefit from some therapeutic counseling… at
least _this_ crazy-making year of government-issued assault, kidnapping and
very bad sex.

**Trumped Up Trauma**

Whether you’re an innocent victim, a vile perpetrator or *just* an observer
watching (and maybe filming) your neighbors getting tackled, beaten, shot and
even murdered by Trump’s ICE [Ammosexual
Incel](https://drsusanblock.com/ammosexual-incel) Army - or perhaps you’re
*just* reading about powerful people doing awful things in the Epstein Files -
you have been [traumatized](https://drsusanblock.com/trauma-kink) much of this
year.

It hasn’t only been a year, of course. We the Peoples of America (including
the Americas that [Bad
Bunny](https://x.com/makerz_king/status/2020873444485931252) so boldly and
accurately listed) and most of the world have been [under
assault](https://drsusanblock.com/post-trump-sex-disorder) by the narcissistic
and sociopathic proclivities of our so-called *leaders* for centuries. But the
most recent assault by the
[billionaire](https://www.counterpunch.org/2025/02/28/fight-the-billionaire-
mind-virus/) class (usually the main assaulters) is the subject of my State of
the Sexual Union (SOTSU) 2026. Though it includes politics, war, finance, art,
the environment and more, it is, to a great degree, a sexual assault.

**“The Noblest of Warriors”**

My SOTSU 2026 went live early [Valentine’s
morning](https://drsusanblock.com/max-collage-valentine), since this year,
sadly, I had [no Valentine](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/02/13/valentine-
blues-high-holidays-of-love-in-low-times/) keeping me in bed. Hartley indulged
me for a few minutes as I mourned my sweet Valentine, saying his name(s) [Pr.
Maximillian Rudolph Leblovic Lobkowicz di
Filangieri](https://www.counterpunch.org/2025/06/20/captain-max-an-
extraordinary-life/), aka “[Captain Max](https://drsusanblock.com/max-
lobkowicz-filangieri),” aka [Mickey](https://drsusanblock.com/max-collage-
family) and more, and singing his praises as my truly amazing husband of [33
years](https://drsusanblock.com/33rd-wedding-anniversary), friend of 40,
lover, [co-host](https://fdrradio.com/), producer,
[publisher](https://drsusanblock.com/speakeasy), butler, my witness and a
great, inspirational Free Speech freedom fighter whose only firearm was his
powerful voice.

Hartley joined in on the eulogizing, letting his listeners know that Max was
“the noblest of warriors… at the front lines of Free Speech struggles… and a
lot of people who've never heard of him owe him a great debt of gratitude.”

That warmed my broken heart, and provided a good point to declare, as I had at
our [Max to the Maximus](https://drsusanblock.com/max-to-the-maximus), “by the
powers vested in me as [Mayor](https://drsusanblock.com/free-speech-woman) of
[Bonoboville](https://drsusanblock.com/bonoboville),” that
[Max](https://www.dignitymemorial.com/obituaries/los-angeles-ca/maximillian-
lobkowicz-12396320)’s birthday, November 8th, be celebrated in perpetuity as
“Free Speech Day.” Mark your calendar - Sunday, November 8th, 2026 - to
exercise your freedom to speak out about something important to you, or
support somebody else’s.

As [V-Day](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/02/13/valentine-blues-high-
holidays-of-love-in-low-times/) was dawning, I then told the [story of
Lupercalia](https://drsusanblock.com/valentine-lupercalia), the original,
[ecosexual](https://drsusanblock.com/ecosexuality), communal,
[Pan](https://drsusanblock.com/lupercalia-2020#Pan)-centered and rather
[kinky](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/kink) Valentine’s Day, as well as
the more recently ordained [World Bonobo
Day](https://drsusanblock.com/valentine-2019#bonobo), honoring the [Love
Apes](https://www.counterpunch.org/2021/08/20/survival-of-the-friendliest/) on
our High Holiday of Love, our kissing cousins, the
[bonobos](https://blockbonobofoundation.org/) ([_Pan
paniscus_](https://drsusanblock.com/uc-berkeley-bonobo-way)), who have long
inspired Max and my love for each other, for Bonoboville and for this lovely,
crazy-making world of ours.

**Epstein Slime & Slop**

“This is what so many people have been waiting for all year,” Hartley told his
rapt audience as we returned from commercials, “for Dr. Suzy to bestow upon us
the State of the Sexual Union (SOTSU). It couldn't come at a more appropriate
time.”

For the past five years, I’ve delivered my SOTSU _after_ the President does
his State of the Union (SOTU). This year, I decided to do mine before him,
feeling no need to let that lying blowhard go first. All recent
[U.S.](http://www.drsusanblock.com/editorial/terror/terror17.htm)
[Presidents](http://www.drsusanblock.com/editorial/terror/terror11.htm) could
reasonably be called [war
criminals](https://archive.drsusanblock.com/editorial/Terror/terrorjournal.htm).
But the current occupier of the now garishly gold-plated Oval Office has
poisoned this past year with words and actions so cruel, dishonest,
narcissistic, self-serving, racist, misogynist and simply obnoxious, it’s
abusive to the spirit of our country, including our sexual spirit. If anyone
in the current U.S. governmental circus of clowns, thieves, fixers, scammers,
cover-up queens, [close
relatives](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/01/22/trumps-board-of-peace-is-a-
grift-on-global-scale/) and ammosexual sociopaths had a pinch of integrity,
Predator [Donald J. Trump](https://drsusanblock.com/tag/trump) wouldn't even
be delivering SOTU 2026. He would be in therapy – mandated by his warden.

And yes, “Predator Trump” suits him so much more than “President”… Indeed, the
State of the Sexual Union 2026 has been grossly stained by his “[best
friend](https://www.nytimes.com/2025/12/18/us/jeffrey-epstein-donald-
trump.html)’s” _magnum opus_ : the Epstein Files, and no matter how much he
whines, “No one cares,” “[I’m
exonerated](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1wmsmFAuDts),” “the stock market
is through the roof,” or “He
[stole](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/iXJqA2MMXvQ) my
[masseuse](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/trump-says-epstein-stole-
young-women-from-mar-a-lago-spa-including-virginia-giuffre),” that damn stain,
like [Lady Macbeth’s damn
spot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sleepwalking_scene) (“[Out damn
spot](https://shakespeare.mit.edu/macbeth/macbeth.5.1.html)!”), just won’t
come out.

Honestly, My AI advisor advised me to “take the high road” and not soil myself
by even mentioning Epstein in my SOTSU 2026. But that would have been rude, as
right out the gate, Hartley asked me to address it as “the number one story in
the world right now.”

It’s my SOTSU, but it’s Hartley’s show, so I had to respect that. Also, he’s
right. Being “America’s #1 Sexologist,” as he so kindly calls me, it was
incumbent upon me to address the Epstein variant of the virulent [Billionaire
Mind Virus](https://www.counterpunch.org/2025/02/28/fight-the-billionaire-
mind-virus/) (BMV), as part of the “therapy” I was prescribing for us all.

And with that, Hartley gave me “the floor,” slippery with the noxious “natural
and unnatural” secretions of the Epstein Files. I pulled on my rubber
Power-[Booties](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/boot) and stepped through
the mess (some of it), trying not to slip and fall on my proverbial ass, as so
many have and still are doing.

And oh, what a mess it is.

For most of us, discussing, scrolling through or even just thinking about
Epstein and the malevolent powers that he represents triggers grim memories of
past traumas or paralyzing fears of future ones. Most of us also have deep,
heart-wrenching empathy for the survivors who are coming forward to tell their
stories or who were mysteriously killed before they could – or after they did.
No wonder we all need therapy.

**Zuck Cucked by Epstein**

I did manage to refrain from (much) gossiping about the “Who’s who,” “What’s
what,” or “Who did what to whom” of the Epstein Files. I can’t say I wasn’t
tempted, but it is so difficult to tell facts from
[fantasy](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/sexual-fantasies), or AI slop from
real-life slime, and I didn’t want to step in that particular kind of mess.

Though I must confess I did snigger a bit over one name (over 300 times) and
distinctive face in the Epstein Files: [Mark Zuck the
Cuckerberg](https://drsusanblock.com/meta) – my thirsty nerd
[nemesis](https://drsusanblock.com/tag/meta) who unjustly deactivated my [Meta
accounts](https://www.counterpunch.org/2024/11/07/free-speech-woman-vs-zuck-
the-cuck-round-ii/) last year – was and still is an integral part of the Tech
Bro branch of Epstein’s swamp, one of a handful of leaders of the expanding
[Censorship Industrial Complex](https://drsusanblock.com/free-speech-woman),
all suffering from variants of the [BMV](https://drsusanblock.com/billionaire-
mind-virus). Epstein’s snapshot of their “wild” 2015
[dinner](https://www.forbes.com/sites/zacharyfolk/2026/02/08/mark-zuckerberg-
and-elon-musk-seen-at-dinner-in-epstein-files-photo/) shows a clear sideview
of Zuck – so thoroughly [cucked](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/wp-
content/uploads/2015/06/wbiehs135.pdf), he’s seated right beside the disgraced
(but still toxically potent) old bull himself.

**Ammosexual Incels & Kidnapping Kink**

A [pro-bonobo](https://bonoboway.com/) man who loves women, Hartley expressed
alarm at the expanding ranks of
[misogynistic](https://www.counterpunch.org/2023/05/05/ammosexual-incels-a-
primer/), Trump-adoring
[incels](https://www.counterpunch.org/2020/05/29/incel-terrorism/)
(“[involuntary celibates](https://www.counterpunch.org/2014/05/29/hunger-
games-killing-fields/)”). I assured him that some are harmlessly pathetic and
just need a good [dominatrix](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/domination) (a
kind of [therapy](https://drsusanblock.com/trauma-kink)!). More concerning are
the “[ _ammosexual_
incels](https://www.counterpunch.org/2023/05/05/ammosexual-incels-a-primer/)”
channeling their much-denigrated sex drives into wielding
[phallic](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/penis) weapons of [various
kinds](https://www.counterpunch.org/2018/05/04/incel-therapy-bonobo-style/) –
which is often all it takes to get a good-paying job assaulting people with
ICE.

Trump’s well-known taste for assault extends into many sociopathic directions,
but on SOTSU 2026, I focused on his kidnapping or “[grab ‘em by the
pussy](https://drsusanblock.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/Pussy-Grabber-
Trump.jpg)” [fetish](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/wp-
content/uploads/2015/06/wbiehs1541.pdf) for capturing people for sexual or
political purposes. This is on appalling display in the kidnapping of American
citizens and visitors by Trump’s ammosexual ICE army, and even geopolitical
actions, such as the kidnapping of Venezuelan President [Nicolás
Maduro](https://www.war.gov/News/News-Stories/Article/Article/4370431/trump-
announces-us-militarys-capture-of-maduro/) and his wife – in addition to the
sordid nonconsensual [kidnapping](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/epstein-files-
juliette-bryant-trafficked-from-south-africa-assaulted-on-jet/) events
described in the Epstein files.

Usually, Trump’s kidnapping hijinks are just for sadistic *fun* (eww!) – at
the victims’ expense – or to make a political power point or entertain his
more bloodthirsty fans. But sometimes it spills over into
[murder](https://x.com/ZoydintheVoid/status/1995514703561515207)…
[Whoops](https://www.wionews.com/world/-jesus-watches-over-her-whoops-
disturbing-epstein-files-email-mocking-young-victim-s-faith-goes-
viral-1771055911141), as Epstein would
[say](https://www.aol.com/articles/jeffrey-epstein-replied-whoops-
told-160652561.html).

Have I mentioned Trump should be in therapy – supervised by his prison
director?

**Pro-Bonobo Therapy for All**

We the People also need therapy; though not in prison (there are many kinds of
counseling and other treatments), and yes, the
[billionaires](https://www.counterpunch.org/2021/07/30/billionaire-dicks-in-
space-race/) should pay for it, as the essential mental health component of
[Medicare for All](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Medicare_for_All_Act). It’s
time.

After all, our compromised leaders and their filthy rich donors’
aggrandizements, appetites, kinks, inadequacies, delusions and bottomless
desires for [domination](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/domination) have
been the lethal power behind our collective trauma. Such is the State of the
Sexual Union 2026.

As I write this, Epstein files keep dropping like cancer-laced stink bombs,
and ICE – though seemingly routed from brave
[Minneapolis](https://x.com/JonWiener1/status/2022803790706151650) – is
[continuing](https://x.com/Cadigan/status/2023337541621997970) its
nonconsensual kidnappings around the country. Many peoples are being
threatened. Not sexy!

In all the combustible confusion of fact with fantasy and criminality with
authority, these don’t seem to be Democrat vs. Republican, Liberal vs.
Conservative issues, not this year anyway. “It’s really not about the Red or
Blue, it’s just folks like me and you,” is my SOTSU 2026 paraphrase of my
wonderful [Counterpunch](https://www.counterpunch.org/author/benex5w111/)
colleague [David Rovics](https://www.counterpunch.org/author/david-rovics/) –
who recently played a fantastic private concert in
[Bonoboville](https://drsusanblock.com/bonoboville) with his band, the
Ministry of Culture (including the lovely Kamala Emanuel), that we’ll release
soon. I was especially touched that David composed a rather catchy new AI
Tsuno song entitled “[Captain Max, Dr. Suzy and the Bonobo
Way](https://soundcloud.com/davidrovics/captain-max).”

And yes, there’s still [pro-bonobo](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/bonobo-
liberation-therapy) goodness in the world, and it’s my fervent SOTSU hope that
the [make-love-not-war](https://www.counterpunch.org/2022/10/06/make-kink-not-
war/), [female-empowered](https://drsusanblock.com/bonobo-female-empowerment),
[male-nurturing](https://www.counterpunch.org/2022/12/09/yale-reunion-
bulldogs-go-bonobos/), [sharing](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/01/01/go-
bonobos-in-2026/), [caregiving](https://drsusanblock.com/go-bonobos-2025)
[bonobos](https://blockbonobofoundation.org/) can guide us through all this
Epstein and ICE slime and crime. The “Epstein class” has captured, censored,
deactivated, demoralized and de-eroticized us, putting some eight billion
humans and gazillions of other precious life forms under the greasy thumbs of
a handful of neoreactionary, sociopathically thirsty rich guys (and a few
gals).

**Don’t Let the Creeps Kill Your Vibe**

Over this Year of Needing Therapy, we've all been kidnapped – some of us
literally, most of us mentally – by the
Trump/Epstein/ICE/Zuck/Zionist/Palantir/PayPal Mafia of Creeps. That’s a
extremel hyphenated adjective, but we now find ourselves in an extreme kink
relationship that, for most of us here on the bottom, is inarguably
nonconsensual and gross – and that’s part of what turns these creeps on.

I could have had a little fun
[roleplaying](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/erotic-theater-therapy) that
scenario in less grievous times. Instead, I tried to focus SOTSU 2026 on how
we can [heal](https://drsusanblock.com/sexual-healing) from the Epstein files
as they pour forth, demolishing our trust in these creepy leaders and systems
– which may be good – but also in each other, which is sad. Unless you too are
a sociopath, the stories that emerge from these files are a major turn-off,
making some of us lose our own healthy appetites for sex and even love.

As a [sex therapist](https://drsusanblockinstitute.com/sex-therapy) who firmly
believes that good sex is vital to our mental and physical health, I
encouraged my SOTSU audience not to let the evils of our deeply disturbed
rulers destroy us “as good people and as sexual beings.” This is easier said
than done, but it’s my hope that we can remember that while people –
especially the powerful ones – can make a mess of just about anything,
including sex, it’s been proven time and again that good sex is far more
likely to [heal](https://drsusanblock.com/sexual-healing) than harm.

In its healthy form, consenting adult sex builds connection, lowers stress,
boosts confidence and tends to make you nicer to be around. A little good sex
puts you into a better mood and, if more of us were having it instead of
scrolling through slime, slop and manufactured outrage, society might be in a
better mood too. A partner is great (and I miss mine) but not necessary so, I
added, “make love to someone you love today… even if that someone is you.”

**Farewell Dr. Jane Goodall**

Just before the sign-off, it occurred to me that we really should say goodbye
to the late great Dr. Jane Goodall, and in that moment of synchronicity,
Hartley did just that. [RIP Dr. Jane
Goodall](https://x.com/drsuzy/status/1973489681858961463), a giant of
primatology, ecology and love, who sadly passed away shortly after Max. One of
my favorite nicknames was “[Jane Goodall After
Dark](https://www.amazon.com/gp/customer-
reviews/R2L052XZ2K1E5O/ref=cm_cr_getr_d_rvw_ttl?ie=UTF8)” (thank you [Tom
Quinn](https://archive.drsusanblock.com/pressquotes.htm)).

Dr. Jane made her mark by studying common chimpanzees, but she was a great
friend of the [bonobos](https://bonoboway.com/). When I sent her _[The Bonobo
Way](https://www.amazon.com/Bonobo-Way-Evolution-through-Pleasure-
ebook/dp/B00ODR23WE/)_ , her assistant [Chris
Hildreth](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hildreth-chris/) messaged me that she
“[loved it](https://drsusanblock.com/goodall).” That’s a lot more than I can
say about another celebrity (whom I did not name) who had said that he
[feared](https://drsusanblock.com/alchemy-fear-sex) he might be misunderstood
if he endorsed such a sex-positive book, and now… he’s in the Epstein files.

That guy definitely needs therapy, but honestly, so do we all. The architects
of this mess should get theirs in prison. The rest of us just need a couch and
some kind of caring counselor (with or without a license, depending on our
needs) who can help us untangle whatever we’re dealing with – as individuals
and as a society – in this sanity-testing Year of Needing Therapy.

It’s also the Year of the Fire Horse, said to be a time of [intense
transformation](https://www.today.com/life/astrology/fire-horse-lunar-new-
year-chinese-zodiac-meaning-rcna259324) and courage. May we all be [brave as
fire horses](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/astrology/vastu-feng-
shui/chinese-zodiac-2026-who-will-thrive-in-the-year-of-the-fire-
horse/articleshow/128376808.cms) in resisting
[fascism](https://drsusanblock.com/fdr-fascism) and transforming tyranny into
community. May we [go bonobos](https://www.counterpunch.org/2026/01/01/go-
bonobos-in-2026/), give what we can and get what we need.

God and Goddess bless America – all the Americas – and the world.
